limitations: EV-0064 is pre-commit evidence over frozen dirty source lanes; EV-0065 must bind clean child commits, the root candidate, and the final repository-local v6 prefix.

The frozen pre-commit setup script intentionally cannot pass --all or --verify: its child locks still name the CP27 heads while the 21-path gem5 and 15-path runtime CP28 lanes are dirty. EV-0064 applies the same reviewed export/build transform to exact immutable inputs in isolated temporary paths; it does not claim that this pre-commit setup invocation installed a product.
Only the post-child-commit setup script plus a final repository-local v6 --all build may serve as CP28 product-install authority, and that proof is reserved for EV-0065.

EV-0064 uses a clean external runtime-build-3d99fcb6 whose ABI 1.6 DSO bakes the exact external runtime-prefix-3d99fcb6, current gem5 binary/config, and repository paths. The ordinary Python E2E environment contains no SAGR_* override or external endpoint. This temporary prefix is pre-commit evidence only; EV-0065 must independently prove the repository-local v6 baked defaults.

EV-0065 must independently bind the final v6 runtime SONAME symlink to its versioned DSO by target and digest, and prove the ordinary Python process maps that exact resolved DSO; EV-0064's isolated runtime mapping does not substitute for the final-prefix check.

The retained root snapshot is the pre-child-commit candidate requested for EV-0064. Child-head constants in setup_rocm_env.sh are expected to change after the EV-0064-backed child commits; EV-0065 must bind that final setup script rather than treating this snapshot as the final root candidate.

The daemon trace fields launcher=false, compiler=false, jit=false, and triton=false delimit daemon-only authority and do not observe the Python driver API. Overall Triton client E2E is established only by combining the installed-wheel ordinary-Python command, its fresh compiled cache, the prefix-local runtime mapping, and the daemon execution trace.
The 5736-byte 03dd mixed-LLVM HSACO is historical NON-PASSING input. M6VyhZ is retained only as a negative pre-relink diagnostic with an empty trace and cannot support acceptance.

The separate CP17 triton_vecadd_compile regression remains in the clean runtime test graph, but no CP17 path enters any core runtime DSO compile command. EV-0064 does not reclassify that legacy compile-only fixture as the canonical CP28 artifact.

The CP28 trace schema has no kernel mapping_id field. Reuse of the kernel source packet is inferred from the stable image hash, packet VA, packet CRC, trace, ticket, and dispatch identifiers; EV-0064 does not claim direct mapping-handle identity evidence.

The trace emits D2H durability only on the final session-complete event, after the second launch. First-launch correctness is supported by its retired output CRC and the exact ordinary-Python oracle, but first-launch D2H durability is not independently emitted.
The historical v5 prefix remains valid only as CP27 OpenCL regression evidence and is NON-PASSING for CP28 because its runtime ABI is 1.5 rather than 1.6.
The managed runtime configure_spawn failure path can leave partially initialized posix_spawn actions or attributes undisposed; successful accepted launches do not exercise that failure path.

sagr_managed_kernel_launch combines submit and wait in one public call and does not return its internal ticket. A timeout or cancellation after successful submit therefore cannot be retried through that public managed call without risking a new submission; EV-0064 exercises only successful completion.
Only vector add is accepted here. The model operator matrix, full model, TP/CCL, and stable multi-token inference are not implemented or claimed.
CP28 accepts base-pointer tensors used by vector add; end-to-end simulator execution of nonzero-offset tensor views remains outside this checkpoint even though focused staging validation is retained.
Explicit runtime close reports errors strictly, while interpreter atexit close is necessarily best-effort; the authoritative traces independently prove complete cleanup for every accepted launch.
Profiling and performance optimization remain deferred because the observed single-operator latency does not block correctness progress.
result: Frozen source, exact products, package proof, focused tests, historical regressions, runtime reuse, and ordinary Python dual execution pass with bit-exact output and no fallback.
